keywords.title: Keywords (optional)
keywords.description: Only return jobs whose title, company, tags or category contain any of these words, e.g. ["python", "data engineer"]. Leave empty for the latest jobs from every board.

maxJobsPerSource.title: Max jobs per board
maxJobsPerSource.description: Cap on rows pushed from each board.

maxRows.title: Max total rows
maxRows.description: Overall cap on rows pushed in one run.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within days (optional)
postedWithinDays.description: Only return jobs posted in the last N days. 0 disables the filter.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (optional)
proxyConfiguration.description: Usually not needed. All four boards serve keyless public feeds.
